title: DoP & TRAI Sign MoU for Village-Level Telecom Survey Across 5.68 Lakh Villages
summary: Department of Posts uses nationwide postal network to conduct India's largest rural telecom audit.

blocks.content: Department of Posts uses nationwide postal network to conduct India's largest rural telecom audit.

items: Audit Scale: Field survey assessing mobile network performance of Airtel, Jio, Vi, and BSNL across 5.68 lakh villages.
Execution Mechanism: Department of Posts conducts field operations; TRAI provides survey app and technical monitoring.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: TRAI Chairman: Anil Kumar Lahoti | Established under TRAI Act 1997.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Survey village coverage (5.68 lakh villages) vs executing agency (Department of Posts).
